summary: Vesmo Elektromotory a.s., Czech motor maker (1,200 staff, solid credit); we are 1.15 % of its turnover and growing 20 %. Copper is bought forward until March 2027, so index and copper arguments will not move it. Margins are thin (price 1.7-1.9 % over its should-cost). We have leverage: sup:70510 holds 70 % of the 4 kW motor and is qualified for the 15 kW. Use the quota shift, scorecard and binding volume.
notes: It needs volume (it is reviewing small accounts) and fears losing share to sup:70510. Its hedge cuts both ways: it cannot claim copper-driven increases before April 2027. OTD sits at 81-85 % against a 95 % target, ppm rose to 764 and one 8D is open. Price moves above 2 % need its pricing committee.
fears: being dropped as a small account

Offer a binding annual volume; it says it focuses on customers with volume.
Turn its own hedge letter against any copper-driven ask.
